visual_logic.color_palette: Dark slate-blue with a creamy-yellow underbelly and a subtle 'frill' of dark clay scales along the spine, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The flattened, croc-like skull is oriented perfectly to face laterally in the frame, allowing a clean view of the powerful jaw.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Jagged, mud-brown 'bark' patterns to blend with roots, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.environment: Vibrant blue water. The massive white 'clay' splashes and Metasequoia leaf litter are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The freshwater mosasaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original resting pose on the riverbed is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its flattened skull, elongated torso, limbs, and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
